about_the_game:
Are you ready for your shift?

Take on the role of a doctor in a busy emergency room - where every second can mean the difference between life and death. 

Immerse yourself in a realistic hospital environment with authentic medical equipment and realistic procedures. Each shift will challenge you to make quick yet accurate decisions to save your patients' lives. 

Emergency Room Simulator is an interactive journey into the world of emergency medicine. Can you stay calm when it matters most?

Features

  • Realistic Hospital Setting

    Navigate a detailed and immersive emergency room filled with authentic medical tools and surroundings 

  • Save Lives Under Pressure

    Perform emergency treatments in time-critical situations where every second counts 

  • You Are the Doctor

    Diagnose and treat your own patients 

  • Medical Detective Work

    Examine patients, ask specific questions, run diagnostic tests, and record your findings in the patient file

  • Your Choices Matter

    Prioritize diagnoses based on your judgment and choose which path you want to pursue first 

  • Interactive Procedures

    Test your skills, reflexes, and decision-making with hands-on medical tasks that simulate real-life challenges

  • Dynamic Gameplay

    Enjoy a balanced mix of calm moments, and sudden, high-stress emergencies

short_description: In Emergency Room Simulator, you become a dedicated doctor in the emergency room, responsible for diagnosing and treating patients as well as saving lives. This professional simulation offers an immersive experience of working in a fast-paced medical environment.
